title: Fixed Twin Link and Jointed Wing Crank Bird
description: One newly authored complete hand-crank winged-bird toy in a single fixed display pose. A common low wooden bed supports two fore-aft shaft standards, a full longitudinal axle, two offset crank cheeks and separate side linkage rods. Each complete rod joins a distinct short forward rocker at the root of one broad tapered thick wing. Two whole wing hinge pins run fore-aft through finite collars beside an independently authored rounded wooden bird body; a rear upright supports the body above the open crank bay. A short neck and rounded head, blunt beak, two small eyes and a whole fan tail complete the bird silhouette. A forward crank and entire hand grip belong to the low shaft. All visible geometry is newly authored: not an old spring rider with its spring removed, an old animal mounted on a base, or a string puppet with renamed limbs. The two shaft-to-wing rod paths are a fixed illustrative mechanical relationship, not an evaluated kinematic system. Four opaque constant PBR materials, one complete toy prop zero scenes, metres native Z up and complete horizontal-bounds-centred finite base datum. Static display art only: no cranking, wing motion, rigging, working joint travel, transmission ratio, flight, balance, toy operation, child suitability, handling, fabrication, pinch protection or safety claim. Animation and interaction not made.
